india.one_line: India becomes ChatGPT's largest market, while OpenAI and Chariot roll out local infrastructure and multilingual tools.

themes.title: OpenAI expands infrastructure as India grows
themes.text: India is now ChatGPT's largest market globally by weekly active users, prompting OpenAI to launch local API inference residency for regulated sectors.

stories.headline: OpenAI adds API inference residency for GPT-6 Luna in India

themes.title: Chariot launches multilingual speech model
themes.text: Research lab Chariot released a text-to-speech model supporting 11 Indian languages and English, featuring contextual reasoning and voice cloning.

stories.headline: Chariot launches multilingual TTS model with support for 11 Indian languages
